snippet.title: Liminal Angel  │  Game Trailer [HORROR]
snippet.description:
Demons have possessed the wildlife, turning animals against humanity. As an angel in human form, you must prepare for a perilous journey. Meet the survivors without revealing your true identity, gather your gear, and evade demon-possessed beasts before dawn breaks. 

Game type: [ Roguelike ]
